question: What lifetime-tax cost slabs and rates for newly registered electric private cars does Part A5(a) of the 2026 Act state?
response: {"status":"supported","points":[{"text":"Part A5(a) of the Karnataka Motor Vehicles Taxation (Amendment) Act 2026 sets the lifetime‑tax for newly registered electric motor cars, jeeps, omni‑buses and private‑service vehicles as a percentage of the vehicle’s cost: ≤ Rs 10 lakh → 5 % of cost; > Rs 10 lakh and ≤ Rs 25 lakh → 8 % of cost; > Rs 25 lakh → 10 % of cost.","citations":["S2"]}]}
